description: This file defines a class 'main_listener' that implements event handling for a phpBB extension related to 'Quick Title Edition'. It subscribes to various forum and posting events to modify topic attributes, titles, and user info display.

classes.name: main_listener
classes.description: Event listener class for phpBB extension handling forum and post events to manage custom topic attributes and titles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for request, template, user, log, and qte objects.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of forum and posting events with corresponding handler methods.

methods.name: viewforum_assign_topic_attributes
methods.description: Assigns topic attribute display if topic_attr_id is set.

methods.name: viewforum_get_user_infos
methods.description: Fetches user info for topics in a list.

methods.name: viewtopic_attr_title
methods.description: Modifies page title with topic attribute title if available.

methods.name: viewtopic_select_assign_attributes
methods.description: Assigns topic attribute display and selection options in viewtopic.

methods.name: viewtopic_attr_apply
methods.description: Applies a selected attribute to a topic based on request variable.

methods.name: posting_select_assign_attributes
methods.description: Handles attribute selection during posting, with custom logic for user and topic.

methods.name: posting_check_attribute
methods.description: Validates attribute selection during post submission.

methods.name: posting_submit_data
methods.description: Prepares data for saving, handling attribute logic.

methods.name: posting_save_attribute
methods.description: Saves attribute data to database and logs changes.
